app.name: Teregna
app.meaning: the one whose turn it is
app.description: Find a provider, join their queue, and watch your place move. No standing in line, no calling ahead.

landing.body: Find a barber, a tailor, a clinic. Send a request and take your place in their queue. Watch your position move without standing in a line or calling ahead.

discovery.title: Find a provider
discovery.subtitle: Browse without an account. You only sign in when you send a request.
discovery.loadFailedBody: Check your connection and try again.
discovery.emptyFiltered: Try a different name, or clear the filters.
discovery.emptyNone: No providers are open right now. Check back shortly.

provider.nothingListed: This provider has not listed anything yet. You can still send a request with a note.
provider.queueWaiting: {count, plural, =0 {No queue} one {# waiting} other {# waiting}}

request.sheetSubtitle: Pick what you need. Everything here is optional except sending.
request.notePlaceholder: In a bit of a hurry
request.signInAndJoin: Sign in and join the queue
request.resumedTitle: Picked up where you left off

stock.noneLeftWarning: {name} may run out before your turn. {provider} has {count, plural, =0 {none} one {# } other {# }} left for everyone already in the queue.
stock.warningTitle: Some of these may run out
stock.warningBody: The provider counts what they have on hand. You can still send this request — they will see it and can tell you when it is your turn.
stock.stockHint: Leave empty if you do not count this item. Customers see what is left after everyone already queued.

myRequests.title: My requests
myRequests.subtitle: Your place updates on its own. No need to refresh.
myRequests.emptyTitle: You are not in any queues
myRequests.emptyBody: Find a provider and send a request. Your place will show up here.

queue.title: Queue
queue.emptyOpen: New requests land here the moment they arrive.
queue.emptyClosed: You are closed, so nobody can send a request. Open up in Settings.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Everything you finished or cancelled. Nothing here is gone — you can send any of it back to the queue.
archive.restoredBody: It joined the end of the line.
archive.emptyBody: Requests land here once you finish or cancel them.

items.title: Items
items.subtitle: Hidden items disappear for customers straight away. Nothing already requested is affected.
items.emptyBody: Add what you offer so customers know what to ask for.
items.orderNote: Customers see them in this order.
items.name: Name
items.minutesHint: Minutes are not shown to customers yet. They will be used to estimate waiting times.
items.showToCustomersHint: Hidden items stay in your list but nobody can request them.
items.removedBody: Past requests keep the name and price they were sent with.
items.confirmRemoveBody: Customers will stop seeing it immediately. Requests that already included it keep the name and price they were sent with, so your history stays accurate.
items.confirmRemoveHide: If you only want to take it off the menu for now, hide it instead — that is reversible.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: How the queue has been moving.
analytics.waitingNowHint: Live, not part of the range
analytics.overTimeHint: Every day in the range, including the quiet ones.
analytics.mostRequestedHint: By number of requests that included the item.
analytics.nothingRecorded: Nothing recorded in this period yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.openForRequestsHint: Closing hides you from search and stops new requests. Your current queue is untouched, so you can finish the people already waiting.
settings.openedBody: Customers can find you and send requests.
settings.closedBody: Nobody new can join. Everyone already queued is still there.
settings.name: Name
settings.languageHint: Applies everywhere, on every device you sign in on.

setup.titleSome: {count, plural, one {# thing left} other {# things left}} before customers can find you
setup.body: Your queue stays empty until your listing is complete and at least one service is visible.
setup.visible: Make a service visible to customers

onboarding.businessSubtitle: This is what customers see when they find you.
onboarding.locationHint: Customers filter by area, so be specific enough to be found.
onboarding.descriptionPlaceholder: Classic cuts and hot-towel shaves. Walk-ins welcome.
onboarding.contactSubtitle: Your phone number is not shown publicly. It is how we reach you about your account.
onboarding.servicesSubtitle: Customers pick from this list when they send a request. You can change it any time.
onboarding.minutesHint: Minutes are optional and never shown to customers yet. They will be used to estimate waiting times in a future update.
onboarding.skipWarning: You can skip this, but your business stays closed until at least one service is listed — customers will not be able to find you.
onboarding.liveBody: Customers can find you and join your queue.
onboarding.createdBody: Add a service when you are ready and we will open you up.

auth.welcomeBackSub: Sign in to send requests and track your place in line.
auth.createAccountSub: One account. Join queues, and run one if you ever want to.
auth.providerSignInSub: Open your queue, manage what you offer, and see how the week went.
auth.badCredentials: That email and password do not match an account. Check them, or create an account.
auth.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is unavailable right now. Use your email instead.
auth.cancelledGoogle: You cancelled the Google sign-in. Try again, or use your email.
auth.oauthFailed: That sign-in did not complete. Try again, or use your email.

account.title: Your account
account.nameHint: Providers see this when you join their queue.
account.eraseDetails: Your name, phone number and photo are erased.
account.cancelActive: Any request you have waiting right now is cancelled.
account.closeBusiness: Your business closes and disappears from search.
account.cancelOthers: Anyone queued with you right now is cancelled and told.
account.historyProvider: Past requests stay in your customers’ own history, listed under a deleted account. Those records are theirs as well as yours, so they are not ours to erase.
account.historyReceiver: Past requests stay in the provider’s records, listed under a deleted account.
account.deletedBody: {count, plural, one {# open request was} other {# open requests were}} cancelled.
account.deleteHintProvider: Deleting your account also closes your business and cancels anyone waiting.
account.deleteHintReceiver: Deleting your account cancels any request you have waiting.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
errors.not_owner: That request is no longer available to you.
errors.provider_inactive: This provider has stopped taking requests for now.
errors.invalid_transition: This request already moved on. Refreshing to catch up.
errors.not_archived: That request is already back in the queue.
errors.too_many_open_requests: You already have three requests open with this provider. Finish or cancel one first.
errors.duplicate_request: That request already went through. Check My requests.
errors.invalid_item: The menu changed while you were choosing. Reload and pick again.
errors.invalid_mode: Something went wrong restoring that request.
errors.invalid_range: Pick an end date that comes after the start date.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
